documents.title: Proceeding Of 3Rd Annual General Meeting Held On 31 July 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Board Meeting Outcome for Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30,2026

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited reported consolidated revenue for FY26 at Rs. 326.15 crores, representing a 12% increase year-on-year, primarily led by its water technologies business. The water segment recorded a 50% volume growth in the second half of the year, carrying forward a strong order book into the new financial year. Management noted that rising material costs since late February have put pressure on earnings and impacted margins by about 3% in the immediate month. The company plans to maintain tight credit policies and deploy cash reserves towards network growth and geographical expansion.

guidance.claim: Chembond stated that its revenue outlook remains positive, although profitability presents a challenge.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive. However, on the earnings, profitability is a little bit of a challenge right now.

guidance.claim: Management foresees 15% to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals in quarter one of the year.
guidance.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

guidance.claim: Management foresees roughly 10% volume growth in water chemicals.
guidance.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

demand_outlook.claim: The water business saw a 50% increase in volume during the second half, with most carrying forward.
demand_outlook.quote: So 50% increase in terms of volume for our water business and most of this is carrying forward.

demand_outlook.claim: Chembond is experiencing significant growth in sealants and plans to consolidate its presence through polysulfide and PU sealants.
demand_outlook.quote: Sealants, we are seeing a significant growth and we intend to consolidate our presence in that segment through our polysulfide and PU sealants.

capex_expansion.claim: CapEx increased to around 21 crores due to office building renovations and the demerger impact on property, plant, and equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: And of course, the office building, the improvements that we've done and the The entire renovation of the office building to house our teams, so that has taken up, but twenty-one crores, whole demerger, yeah, P.P.E. which has come into our books, so this is the demerger effect.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to deploy cash into network growth and geographical expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹90.76 lakhs during FY 2025-26 for the rooftop solar renewable energy plant in Dudhwada, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹90.76 lakhs were invested towards installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at the Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site during FY 2025-26.

margins_costs.claim: Full financial year EBITDA was Rs. 51 crores, up 7% compared to the prior year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the full financial year is at Rs.51 crores, up 7% over prior.

margins_costs.claim: The construction chemicals business operates at a PBT margin of around 20%.
margins_costs.quote: Yeah, I'll just add that in this segment, we are operating at a PBT of about 20 odd percent which is the, I mean, I've not known any of our peers in the industry operating at those levels.

orders_capacity.claim: Chembond is starting the financial year with a strong order book for its chemicals business.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

orders_capacity.claim: The Water BU entered the financial year with a strong order book across both chemicals and equipment.
orders_capacity.quote: Water BU, we are entering this, as I mentioned earlier, with a strong order book for chemicals as well as for the equipment.

capital_allocation.claim: Chembond holds around 65 crores on its books.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we have around sixty-five crores on books.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 per equity share of face value ₹5, totaling ₹336.20 lakhs for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 (Rupee One and Paise Twenty-Five only) per equity share of ₹5 (Rupees Five only) each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Public sector units account for about 30% of the water business, and none had accepted force majeure until the government declared it two weeks prior.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

risks_headwinds.claim: Material costs began rising from late February and March.
risks_headwinds.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March.

management_commitments.claim: Chembond foresees 15% to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals for quarter one of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to deploy cash reserves into network growth and geographical expansion.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
